d: After 13 years of anticipation, the wait is finally over as Grand Theft Auto VI prepares to take the gaming world by storm. Developed by Rockstar Games, GTA 6 takes players back to Vice City in the fictional state of Leonida, following the story of Jason and Lucia. With a vast open world, cinematic storytelling, immersive gameplay and unprecedented hype, the launch is being billed as one of the biggest entertainment events of 2026.
